changelog:
1.2.3 (2026-11-11)

Seeds are unchanged, so map rolls match 1.2.

Fixes
- Erdtree Sentry (field boss): it now fights instead of standing still.
- Bows in the left hand: Devonia's Longbow and bows with the Abyssal Flame Shot skill no longer break your right-hand weapon's skill; L2 now uses the right weapon's skill, like every other bow.
